notes.title: Add menubar in windowed mode
notes.content:
- Make draggable menu bar in windowed mode
- Add steam achievement for repairing the ship with no explosions
- Fix the scale of the achievement button in the HUD by making it the same as the help button.

notes.title: Achievements and Quality of Life updates
notes.content:
- Add support for Steam Achievements.
- Make draggable menu bar in windowed mode for electron app.
- Fix the scale of the achievement button in the HUD by making it the same as the help button.
- Add Blaise's name to Testers for Gem Blast end credits.
- New help text: "If a revealed tile is empty, there will never be anything in or next to it."
- Escape key toggles options, NOT during intro or credits (cutscenes) or incoming/outgoing from digging.
- Add outline for all hexes with pips in them.
- Don't show help or achievements buttons on the title screen.
